assumptions: HEURISTIC: a coordinate-defined factor base may make the target-specialized f4 elimination remainder sparser or cheaper than a matched random-x set.
UNTESTED: product-tree, subresultant, modular-composition, or multipoint structure can exploit any exact sparsity signal without moving target-specific state into advice.
TOY-EVIDENCE: exact support, root, sign, and witness audits are feasible only on the generated development groups.
MODEL-BOUND: the measured dependency-free root-product kernel is an exact census target, not an asymptotically optimized resultant implementation.
falsification_conditions: Any S3 root-set, source-substitution, S4 compatibility, signed witness, or batch/scalar equality invariant fails.
Target-independent translator advice or peak target-specific workspace exceeds 0.8x full-D3 logical storage on either seed at any tested size.
Online work through exact witness recovery exceeds 0.8x scalar exact D2+D3 under any disclosed field-inversion weight.
No fixed coordinate family improves online work or intermediate density by 20 percent against random-x on identical family-independent uniform targets without losing support.
Any supported or matched-uniform coordinate schedule realizes fewer targets than requested.
Any required degree, term-count, explicit-H-write, or weighted-work slope exceeds the symmetry-D3 materialization slope, the density slope is positive, or a required slope is undefined.
The mechanism requires target-specific coefficients, masks, D3 keys, or hidden factor-base scalars in preprocessing advice.
interpretation_limits: A pass is a positive toy signal and does not establish an exponent improvement or ECDLP break.
A failure is scoped to this exact root-product representation and the configured source maps.
Exact D2+D3 and batched inversion are generic comparator or practical constant-factor results.
The development curve constructor is restricted to p mod 4 = 3 and excludes embedding degree at most 20; other field congruence classes require a fresh successor.
Only x_interval versus random_x has an eligible same-map null in this contract; square_map and rational_union comparisons are map-confounded diagnostics.
Relation generation, rank, sparse linear algebra, and individual logarithms are not measured here.
hypothesis.mechanism: Build an exact D2 and D3 fixed-curve complete comparator, then substitute each public source map into the actual fourth Semaev polynomial, eliminate accepted factor roots and one D2 x-orbit by exact products modulo the D2 root polynomial, extract compatible roots by gcd, and recover full signed five-leaf witnesses.

predictions.metric: target-independent translator advice and peak workspace versus full D3 logical bytes
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x on both seeds at all three sizes

predictions.metric: online field work through exact witness recovery versus scalar exact D2+D3
predictions.minimum_effect: at most 0.8x for inversion weights 10, 50, and 100

predictions.metric: coordinate-family online work or exact intermediate density versus random-x on identical family-independent uniform targets
batched D2+D3 inversions and D2 logical reads versus target-major querying
predictions.minimum_effect: at least 20 percent at K=B and K=16B

hypothesis.statement: At least one public coordinate factor base admits an exact source-domain f4 translator whose advice, conservative live workspace bound, and online field work beat full D3 storage and exact D2+D3 querying, with any coordinate-specific advantage persisting against random-x on identical uniform targets.

test_boundary.implementation: Dependency-free Python with exact replay plus independent curve, support, coordinate-compatibility, source-map, advice, workspace, and witness audits.
